Generator.title: Generator
Generator.summary: 458 MVA generator ratings and source CT arrangement, implemented as a dynamic machine equivalent.
Generator.brief: 458 MVA generator ratings and source CT arrangement, implemented as a dynamic machine equivalent.

supported.fact: Siemens SGen5-2000H: 458 MVA, 22 kV, 50 Hz, 3000 rpm.

added.fact: Synchronous-machine block, workbook-based dynamic parameter mapping and 360 MW dispatch scenario.
